sql: SELECT SUM(l.quantity) AS purchased_quantity FROM d4_stress_100000.invoice AS i JOIN d4_stress_100000.invoice_line AS l ON l.invoice_id = i.invoice_id JOIN d4_stress_100000.track AS t ON l.track_id = t.track_id JOIN d4_stress_100000.genre AS g ON t.genre_id = g.genre_id WHERE i.billing_country = 'France' AND g.name = 'Rock'
